name: Sophie Page
source:
Ever since she was a kid, Sophie had a dream. A dream of becoming a kind, hardworking teacher that would always do her best for her students, just like the teachers who were special to her. Now in her early thirties, Sophie is very happy to be working as a professor of mathematics at Riverside Community College alongside her newlywed husband, Felix. They are even thinking of starting a new family. Life is perfect. She is living the life she always wanted. Or so she thinks...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/turning-page-1-69123570]Patreon[/url]]
